records.title: Understand the operating environment
records.rationale: Context, including a 2024 climate-change relevance determination, is documented for the scoped service and its providers. The first scheduled context/management review has not yet operated, so recurring effectiveness is not demonstrated.
gaps: Complete a dated context review through management review or an equivalent operating record after the defined interval or trigger.

records.title: Identify stakeholder security needs
records.rationale: Interested parties and requirement categories, including the 2024 climate-related requirement consideration, are documented. No specific climate-related stakeholder requirement is currently identified, and the first scheduled interested-party review has not yet operated.
gaps: Complete a dated interested-party/requirements review and retain any resulting obligation or supplier changes.

records.title: Define the security management scope
records.rationale: The ISMS boundary, inclusions, exclusions, provider interfaces, and applicability rules are documented. Continued suitability has not yet been confirmed through the first management review.
gaps: Complete the first management review and retain the scope-suitability decision.

records.title: Operate the security management system
records.rationale: The ISMS operating model, controlled Git lifecycle, risk process, evidence model, and improvement interfaces are documented and used. Formal internal audit and the first management review remain incomplete.
gaps: Complete an appropriately objective internal audit and the first management review without converting owner self-review into an audit.

records.title: Leadership accountability for security
records.rationale: Leadership/accountability duties and decision rights are documented and reflected in controlled changes. The first management review and recurring leadership review evidence remain incomplete.
gaps: Complete the first management review and retain attributable decisions/resources/actions.

records.title: Set and maintain security policy
records.rationale: The information-security policy is approved and available in the governed repository. The planned security-policy awareness record AW-001 has not been completed.
gaps: Complete AW-001 and retain dated awareness evidence.

records.title: Assign security roles and authority
records.rationale: Security roles, authorities, delegation, and independence limits are documented. Competence review remains incomplete and formal internal-audit independence has not yet been demonstrated.
gaps: Complete the planned competence review and use a sufficiently objective reviewer for any formal internal audit.

records.title: Plan for security risks and opportunities
records.rationale: Risk principles, treatment choices, and operational reassessment triggers are documented and linked to controlled change. The recurring risk-review cycle has not yet accumulated enough dated operating evidence for Pass.
gaps: Complete and retain the scheduled/event-driven information-security risk reassessment record.

records.title: Plan responses to risks and opportunities
records.rationale: The management system defines how risks and opportunities are incorporated into planning. A complete recurring planning-review interval has not yet been evidenced.
gaps: Retain a dated planning/risk review showing resulting actions or an explicit no-change conclusion.

records.title: Assess information-security risk consistently
records.rationale: A consistent security-risk record, likelihood/impact method, triggers, and reassessment process are defined. Recurring reassessment evidence remains incomplete.
gaps: Perform and retain the next scheduled/event-driven security risk assessment using the defined method.

records.title: Select and treat security risks
records.rationale: Treatment selection, SoA applicability, implementation, and effectiveness interfaces are defined. Treatment verification over an operating interval remains incomplete for several planned controls.
gaps: Retain dated treatment verification and update risk/SoA state when actual operating evidence changes the conclusion.

records.title: Set measurable security objectives
records.rationale: Measurable security objectives, owners, metrics, targets, evidence sources, and cadences are defined. Objective measurement history and first management-review evaluation remain incomplete.
